name: hopewick-native
description: Capacitor shell for the Hopewick iPhone and Android apps. Wraps the same /app/ web code; the website is not affected.

scripts.sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync
scripts.android:debug: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
